mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing nifedipine plasma concentrations and enhancing hypotensive effects; turmeric also has antiplatelet properties that could potentiate bleeding risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; counsel patient to maintain consistent turmeric intake and report dizziness or hypotension; consider nifedipine dose adjustment if significant BP reduction occurs.
